card.name: Punctuation ending a label phrase
card.fires_on: Punctuation (colon, comma, opening bracket or parenthesis, dash) that comes right after a short heading, list item or term in drug-label text, just before the next item or a cross-reference.

modes.label: Comma in lists
modes.description: A comma after a list item, such as a section heading or abbreviation entry, before the next item.

modes.label: Bracket before cross-reference
modes.description: An opening bracket or parenthesis after a contraindication or table title, leading into a see-section reference or a cycle note.

modes.label: Colon after heading
modes.description: A colon after a short label such as a test or assessment name, before instructions.
